content:
Alex R: Hey team, just got an invoice from SigmaCloud (INV-2025-098) for $62,450 but it doesn't show a PO on the header. PDF uploaded: https://s3.company/sigma/invoices/INV-2025-098.pdf — needs approval or routing. Can someone advise?
Priya M: Ping procurement — do we have a PO for SigmaCloud this quarter? I can't find one under SigmaCloud in Coupa. :thinking:
Leah P: I pulled a quick search — we have PO 98765 but that's for 'Sigma Solutions LLC' from Jan (different legal entity). There is also PO 99234 for 'SigmaCloud, Inc' but it's marked closed/fulfilled.
Tomas G: Confirming — PO 99234 was for the Q2 reserved capacity commitment. It was fully invoiced but vendor may have included this as a final reconciliation charge. Do we have the invoice breakdown?
Alex R: PDF has line items for "overage reconciliation" and a net amount. The scanned header shows vendor name SigmaCloud, Inc but the PO number field is blank. Page 2 has a small footer that maybe references PO 99234 (hard to read).
Samir K: I opened the PDF — on page 2 under "Remittance Details" there's a handwritten note: "Ref PO# 99234". I'll attach a clipped screenshot in NetSuite. If procurement confirms, we can match.
Priya M: If it truly ties to 99234 we can route as a PO match, but procurement needs to re-open or mark as final-invoice. Tomas?
Tomas G: I can re-open PO 99234 as a one-time allowance for reconciliation if Finance signs off. Prefer vendor reissue to include PO prominently, but we can match internally.
Alex R: What's the approval path here? This is $62k — needs Director approval + finance. Can someone add this to the approvers queue? @invoices-bot can you push this to the finance-approvers group?
invoices-bot: Invoice INV-2025-098 uploaded to NetSuite by Alex R. Current status: "Needs Coding/Approval". Notified: finance-approvers. (Ref: NS-INV-11458) :white_check_mark:
Leah P: Options: 1) Request vendor reissue with PO 99234 and remittance details (preferred). 2) Match to PO 99234 internally and route for director approval (faster). 3) Reject and ask vendor to dispute if amounts don't align.
Samir K: Finance preference = match & route if procurement confirms the link. I'll prep the GL coding and add a memo referencing the handwritten note.
Priya M: I'll message the vendor sales contact now: "Please reissue invoice INV-2025-098 with PO 99234 on the header or confirm in writing that this invoice reconciles to PO 99234. We need that for matching."
Alex R: Thanks Priya. Also forwarding to @Leah P and @Tomas G for PO action. If vendor confirms, Samir can process. :thumbsup:
Leah P: Noted — I'll re-open PO 99234 as "Accept final reconciliation invoice" once vendor confirmation arrives.
Tomas G: Agree. I'll wait for vendor confirmation before changing PO state.
Priya M: Vendor replied: "We will reissue within 48 hours with PO# included." I'll drop the reissue once received.
Alex R: Great — marking as pending vendor reissue. Please CC finance@redwood on the reissued PDF.
Samir K: Once reissued and NetSuite updated I'll route to Director (L4) for sign-off.
Alex R: Thanks all. Leaving this thread open until the reissued invoice is in.
